Camera about nine meters away at chest height, 85mm f/5.6 so all three faces stay sharp, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS, nothing foreshortened; they are SMALL against a very large dark hall: framed from mid-thigh up, each head is about one ninth of the frame height and a full quarter of the frame stays free above Antonio's head. GEOGRAPHY: Antonio is nearest; the shoulder of his that is nearest the left edge of the frame is at about 60 % of the frame width and his face at about 66 %. Karo is one step behind him and to the right, her near shoulder hidden behind his, her face at about 76 %. Isabella is one more step behind and to the right, her near shoulder hidden behind Karo's, her face at about 86 %; between Isabella's far shoulder and the right edge of the frame there is a narrow band of darkness, about 8 % of the frame width. Between the left edge of the frame and Antonio's body there is a very wide band of empty darkness: from the left edge to 55 % of the frame width there is nobody and nothing lit. THE PHENOMENON: far behind them, some thirty meters back and only in the right third of the frame, a TOWERING WAVE of thousands of small glowing comment bubbles rises like a tide, dim cool azure (#0375DB), anonymous and melted out of focus; its crest peaks above their heads between 80 % of the frame width and the right edge, and it leans toward the camera, never toward the left. THE MOMENT: the wave does not break over them. It splits into THREE thin streams, one per person, each coming down behind that person's frame-right shoulder; in front of each person the stream becomes ONE short, still row of answered bubbles, placed like this: ROW ONE hovers in front of Antonio's stomach, six bubbles side by side, no wider than his shoulders; ROW TWO hovers in front of Karo's stomach, six bubbles, no wider than her shoulders; ROW THREE hovers in front of Isabella's stomach, six bubbles, no wider than her shoulders. There are exactly these three rows and no other white bubbles anywhere. The answered bubbles glow clear cool white, sharp and evenly spaced; no row passes in front of another person and none rises above the embroidered mark on the chest. Karo and Isabella each hold a plain matte black phone low at stomach height, screen turned away from the camera and never visible, its back blank with no logo, and each looks down at her own row: Karo with her crooked, playful half-smile, Isabella with an open, energetic smile; the phone screens are dim and add no light to their faces; no hand, phone or bubble covers the embroidered mark on any chest. Antonio has just finished his row: his arms hang relaxed, his phone lowered at his side, head frontal, and HIS EYES ARE ON THE LENS — both irises centred, looking straight at the viewer — with a calm closed-mouth smile of quiet confidence. THIS SCENE DECIDES THE GAZE and replaces any other gaze instruction in this prompt: Antonio looks into the lens; Karo and Isabella look down at their own row; nobody looks toward the dark left side and nobody looks at anybody else. LIGHT: the three short rows of white answered bubbles are the only key light: they light each face from below and from the frame-right side, cool white, the far side of each face falling into shadow; every pair of eyes stays readable with a catchlight; the light of the identity references does NOT carry over; a faint azure rim from the wave behind separates their hair and shoulders from the dark. In ROW ONE, the bubble nearest Antonio's frame-right hand glows vivid orange (#FF6500), the only accent in the frame; it lights nothing around it. A long dark matte operations desk runs between the camera and them, its near edge just in front of the lens; its top is matte black and non-reflective. The wave, the streams, the three rows and every bubble stay inside the RIGHT half of the frame, never go further left than Antonio's body and never cross a face. The left of the frame is one towering matte black wall of the hall, unlit, that ends in a clean vertical edge at about 48 % of the frame width, well behind Antonio; the wall hides whatever would reach farther left, and no bubble, no glow, no lamp and no point of light is on the wall. The haze only glows softly around the wave on the right; there are NO shafts, beams or columns of light anywhere in the frame and nothing comes down from above. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No warm light apart from that single orange bubble, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos of any other brand.
